## Change and purpose

Describe the user-visible result and scope.

## Evidence

- [ ] Focused diff reviewed, including assets and metadata
- [ ] Relevant tests passed (include commands/results)
- [ ] Publication identity check passed on tracked additions
- [ ] Secrets and real data reviewed separately
- [ ] Substantial change logged under docs/changes; ADR updated if needed
- [ ] Portable example verified from a clean checkout, if applicable

## Limits and recovery

State what remains unverified, how to recover, and whether any deployment or external side effect is involved. Do not imply merge authorizes deployment.
